page_title: RBL 3-0 AUG | RB Leipzig v Augsburg 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+1' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Timo Werner (RB Leipzig) is coming onto the pitch as Yussuf Poulsen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Finn Dahmen intercepts the ball.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ruben Vargas as he is replaced by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg).
81' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Christopher Lenz (RB Leipzig) replaces David Raum.
77' That will be all from Xavi Simons who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
76' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
74' The ball is laid off to Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Janis Blaswich to make a decent save.

73' A neat pass is well received by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
71' Poor challenge! Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) is penalised for tripping and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle.
67' The attendance is 44746.
66' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
66' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
66' David Raum (RB Leipzig) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg have a free kick.
64' Here is a change. Emil Forsberg is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig).
64' The game has come to an end for Lois Openda. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig).
63' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes a direct free kick.
62' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) tackles a bit over-zealously and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
60' Arne Engels (Augsburg) takes the corner kick, but Janis Blaswich reads it well and stops the effort.
59' Arne Engels (Augsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. Now Augsburg have a corner.
59' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) passes the ball onto Ermedin Demirovic, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
57' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
57' Great chance! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort. Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
54' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

52' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Sascha Stegemann with no other option than to blow for a foul. Augsburg have been awarded a free kick.
50' A brilliant cross into the box finds Phillip Tietz (Augsburg), who steers his low header towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
46' Half-time substitution. Mads Pedersen will not participate anymore and Iago (Augsburg) is coming on.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Dion Beljo is replaced by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jeffrey Gouweleeuw will replace Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg).

45+4' Arne Engels (Augsburg) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Janis Blaswich pulls off an easy save.
45+2' Enrico Maassen is forced to make a change. Niklas Dorsch is unable to continue due to injury, Arne Engels (Augsburg) comes on.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' David Raum (RB Leipzig) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

43' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
40' Finn Dahmen pulls off a great save to deny Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
39' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

38' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle as David Raum (RB Leipzig) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. It's a free kick to Augsburg, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

36' A lofted cross from Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
34' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

33' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for an infringement. RB Leipzig win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
27' 3 - 0 David Raum (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
26' Neat passing move from RB Leipzig in order to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
22' An attempted cross from Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Augsburg will take a corner.
19' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
17' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
17' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Janis Blaswich comes off his line to gather the ball.

15' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
11' 2 - 0 Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
10' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

6' 1 - 0 Goal – 1:0! Lois Openda sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the left side of the goal.
5' Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. RB Leipzig have a free kick.
3' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Augsburg will kick the game off.
Sascha Stegemann will supervise the game today.
